entries.title: Create a production build and preview it
entries.summary: 'build' compiles an optimized bundle into dist/; 'preview' serves that bundle locally.
entries.when: Before deploying, and as a final error check after changes.

steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

steps.label: Serve dist/ locally (default http://localhost:4173)
steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

entries.expected: Build ends with a size table and 'built in ...s'. Preview prints a Local URL.
troubleshooting: Build fails but dev works: fix the error shown (often a bad import path, case-sensitivity, or TypeScript error).
Blank page after deploying: check 'base' in vite.config and SPA redirects (see Running > Netlify).
'preview' is for checking, not for real hosting.

entries.title: Environment variables in Vite
entries.summary: Values you do not hardcode (API URLs, public keys), read via import.meta.env.
entries.when: Only when the project needs them - check for .env.example first.
entries.where: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

steps.label: Create the file in the project root

entries.expected: console.log(api) prints your URL. Restart 'npm run dev' after changing .env files.
troubleshooting: undefined: the name must START with VITE_, and the dev server must be restarted.
Anything in the browser bundle is public - never put secret keys in VITE_ variables.
Keep .env/.env.local in .gitignore.
